name: How do I choose the right paint sheen for different rooms and trim?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right paint sheen for different rooms and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Different surfaces require specific sheens to balance durability and light reflection. Flat or matte finishes absorb light and hide imperfections, making them ideal for ceilings and low-traffic master bedrooms. Eggshell and satin provide a gentle sheen that resists scuffs, making them the standard choice for living rooms, hallways, and kids' bedrooms. Semi-gloss is moisture-resistant and easy to clean, which is why we recommend it for baseboards, window casings, interior doors, and high-humidity areas like bathrooms and kitchens. We review these options with you during the initial estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use flat for ceilings, eggshell or satin for living areas and bedrooms, and durable semi-gloss for trim, doors, kitchens, and bathrooms.
